oneOf.description: The transaction never reached a ledger.
It reached a ledger and failed there.
It reached a ledger and succeeded.

CoreRef.description: The stellar-core a table was measured on or read from.

commit.description: The full commit sha the tag names.

image.description: The image that ran, absent for tables read from source.

attempts.description: Every value tried. A verdict rests on at least two.

path.description: The field's path from `TransactionEnvelope`, as `shapekit schema` names it.

ImageRef.description:
A container image: a registry image with its manifest digest, or a local build with its
image id in `digest`.

ProbeAttempt.description: One value of the field, submitted and closed.

result_code.description:
The XDR-JSON arm name of the transaction result, `tx_success` or `tx_bad_seq`; absent
when core returned no result (a pending transaction left out of the ledger).

result_xdr.description:
The `TransactionResult`, base64 XDR, as core returned it at submission or wrote it in
the ledger.

variant.description: The value, in words: `memo id 2^64-1`, `sequence number plus one`.

witnesses.description: The entries holding the envelope and, when it was applied, its ledger.

oneOf.description: Core's tx endpoint could not decode the bytes and returned an exception, no result.

Core refuses or fails some value of the field: the attempts end in at least two
outcomes.

Core checks some property of the field but not all; the attempts end in at least two
outcomes and the ones core accepted include values a full check would refuse.

Every value tried ends in the same outcome. Measured, not proven: a value outside the
tried ones could still be refused.

description: registry/generated/validation.json: for each envelope field, whether core validates it, with every value tried, core's answer to it and the entries that witness it.

core.description: The core every attempt ran on.

fields.description: Sorted by path, each path once.
